pages.text: If either tank cannot take the next tick of by-product, the oven $(item)pauses$(). The timer freezes, the coal stays in the slot and no fluid is lost. As soon as you drain the tank, cooking resumes by itself.

Look at any oven block with $(item)Engineer's Goggles$() to see what is happening. Besides the progress and both tanks, a red line tells you which tank blocks the oven:$(br2)$(li)$(item)CO2 tank full: pump it out from the TOP face$()$(li)$(item)Creosote tank full: pump it out from a side$()

$(l)Checklist$()$(li)No progress at all: is the slot empty, or does it hold something that is not coal or a log?$(li)Stuck at the same time left: a tank is full, read the red line.$(li)Coke piling up in front: the drop zone is blocked or nothing collects it.
$(li)The oven is slower than expected: a block faces another way or is missing, so the square is smaller. Break and replace it facing the front.
